definition: Sum of the administrative county and the separately published Cardiff and Swansea county boroughs across identical age and sex groups. The components match the ancient county's 518,863 statute acres, 157,514 inhabited houses in 1901, 687,218 people in 1891 and 859,931 people in 1901 (443,762 male and 416,169 female). uncertainty: The source counts 1901 administrative Glamorganshire, Cardiff and Swansea separately. The combined age shares use 1,082 as the residual male count at age two in Swansea. Changes in age and sex shares between January 1900 and March 1901 are unquantified.
